message:
I fixed it by changing `uploads.maxMb` in `config/default.json` from 5 to 10, which matches the limit in `docs/product.md`. `npm test` now passes all 4 tests, including the 8 MB upload.

The API body limit in `src/api/body-limit.js` is computed from the same setting, so it now allows 11 MB (10 MB plus the 1 MB multipart overhead).
